China Enacts Sweeping Law to Control Overseas Travel

China has enacted a new law that significantly tightens government control over its citizens' overseas travel. The legislation aims to prevent individuals from engaging in activities deemed detrimental to national security and interests while abroad. It grants authorities broader powers to restrict travel for various reasons, including ongoing investigations or potential threats. The law also targets financial loopholes and corruption, particularly concerning overseas brokerages. This move signals a broader effort by the Chinese government to increase its oversight of citizens and financial activities outside its borders.
